semantic_fixtures.covers: Exact identity, cost, types, power and toughness, presentations, scoped attack tax and graveyard ability.
Two actual Onakkes charge for each attacker assigned to their controller's planeswalkers in a mixed multiplayer declaration.
Synthetic owner and source-control changes distinguish current control from ownership.
Synthetic layer-six suppression and restoration change the active tax.
A must-attack requirement remains for an untaxed player edge, but not when real Propaganda and Onakke tax all available edges.
Wrong payer and stale revision reject; a locked tax can be paid or cancelled after synthetic suppression and a real mana activation.
Real Ironworks sacrifice ends synthetic source-linked suppression; the old tax stays locked while a new declaration sees both Onakkes.
Chandra's Embercat's spell-only mana cannot pay the attack cost.
Accepted wire-encoded declaration, mana, payment and subsequent pass replay deterministically.
The offered graveyard ability uses the exact source and payment, rejects invalid targets and costs, and returns an untapped planeswalker with printed loyalty.
Real zone changes make the targeted card's later graveyard incarnation illegal without refunding costs.
Tishana's Tidebinder counters the activation without refunding mana or the exiled source.
Two real Doubling Seasons pause entry; a surviving controller's choice, exactly-once completion and accepted-wire replay survive another player's departure.
The departed owner's cards and parked choice are removed so survivors can continue.
